summary_en: On 20 October 2026, during Lugano's Plan ₿ Week, the Scientific Bitcoin Institute hosts the SBI Academy Day: a day dedicated to the scientific study of Bitcoin. Programme and details coming soon.
summary_it: Il 20 ottobre 2026, durante la Plan ₿ Week di Lugano, lo Scientific Bitcoin Institute organizza l'SBI Academy Day: una giornata dedicata allo studio scientifico di Bitcoin. Programma e dettagli a breve.
highlights_en: A day dedicated to the scientific study of Bitcoin, hosted by the Scientific Bitcoin Institute.
Part of Lugano's Plan ₿ Week (19–28 October 2026).
Programme and details to be announced.
